records.state_scope: Design Decisions is an undated mixed decision narrative with initial ideas, rationale and an explicitly retained current method. A current status field does not make the entire narrative a current-state snapshot. No authoring chronology is proved.

The document reports feedback received after a rehearsal and records responses. Historical describes that retrospective event/report function, not expiry of the feedback or its applicability. No date or order relative to the current overview is established.

Project Log combines initial experiments, completed changes and still-open questions; its status is ongoing and it has no date. The whole record is neither a pure past-state report nor an explicit current-state snapshot.

Current State is an explicit supplied-state overview with goals, interaction, completed work, blockers and next steps. Its date and actual creation order are unknown; current refers to this document function, not activity on the experiment date.

review_basis: Researcher review of record-level functions and limitations, with confirmation conditional on the completed candidate-pool, query-order and static method audit.
